draft.note: No public link yet. Publish it to get a link and a QR code.

blocked.note: This file never had a public link. Upload a different file to try again.

expired.note: The link stopped serving. Publish again to bring printed QR codes back to life.

quarantined.note: The link and any printed QR code no longer work. Appeal if you think this is wrong.

removed.note: The content is gone from storage. The short link and QR code still work — scanners see a page saying it was taken down.

actions.not_available_yet: This build cannot do that yet — contact support and someone will help
actions.copy_link_locked: Not published yet, so there is no link.

list.title: Artifacts

empty.title: No artifacts yet
empty.description: Upload an HTML page, a PDF, a slide deck or a video to get a link and a QR code you can put on packaging, a standee or a flyer.

menu.make_public_tip: Currently {{mode}}. Press to let anyone with the link view it.
menu.public_now_sub: Anyone with the link can view

list.made_public: {{name}}: anyone with the link can view it. The QR code and short link are unchanged.

create.title: New artifact

dropzone.label: Drop a file here or click to choose
dropzone.hint: HTML, Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image or video — up to {{max}}

name.label: Name
name.hint: Only you and your teammates see this name.
name.placeholder: Name it so you can find it later

slug.label: Path
slug.hint: You can change it later on the detail page; the QR code is regenerated for the new path.
slug.invalid: The path must be {{min}}–{{max}} characters, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only, and cannot start with "f-".
slug.taken: This path is already taken. Pick another one.

create.office_notice: Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are fetched by Microsoft to render the preview.
create.too_large_video: The file is {{size}}, over the {{max}} limit — record at a lower quality or trim it, then try again.

sections.short_link_only_hint: This setting exists on the Short link tab only; it does not apply to artifacts.

create.access_sub: You can change this any time after publishing. Printed QR codes keep working.

qr.section_note: The QR code is built from the path you are setting. Change the path and the code changes with it.
qr.publish_first: Publish first — you can download and copy the QR code after that.

tags.unavailable: Artifacts cannot be tagged yet: the artifacts table has no tag column. Tags are for short links only for now.

public.headline: Opens right away
public.warning: You will not know who opened it. Choose "Sign in with Google" if you want to know.

password.headline: Password first
password.body: The viewer gets a password box and only sees the content after entering it.

google.headline: Sign in with Google
google.body: The viewer signs in with Google and their email is recorded in Customers.

private.headline: Sign-in page
private.body: People outside your organization get a sign-in page, not the content.

created_dialog.title: Published
created_dialog.description: The link and QR code are ready to print or share.

detail.title: Artifact
detail.preview_unavailable: Publish it first to see a preview.
detail.responsibility: Uploaded by a user. Li2 does not review content before publishing and is not responsible for it.
detail.not_found: We could not find this artifact, or it belongs to another organization.

preview.open_direct: Not showing here? Open it in a new tab.
preview.download_to_view: Download it to open in your own app.
preview.serving_note: The version currently served to scanners.

detail.office_viewer_privacy: To display these slides, Microsoft downloads this file. Use Download instead if you would rather it did not.
detail.delete_confirm_description: The file will be deleted from storage and cannot be recovered. The short link and any printed QR codes keep working — scanners will see a page saying the content was taken down.

link.title: Link
link.lead_live: The short link is what gets printed on the QR code. The origin link is the page scanners land on.
link.lead_draft: Not published yet, so there is no link. The path below is used when you publish.
link.hint_live: Change the path, then press Update content. The old path still redirects, and the QR code is regenerated for the new path.
link.hint_draft: {{min}}–{{max}} characters, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only.
link.hint_changed_draft: The new path will be used when you publish.
link.origin_hint: Unchanged when you change the path or replace the file. Use it when you need to embed directly.
link.warn_body: The old path {{slug}} still redirects to this content. New QR codes are generated for the new path.

replace.lead_live: The QR code and short link stay the same.
replace.lead_draft: Not published yet, so nothing outside is affected.

qr.publish_first_hint: Publish it first — the QR code is generated from the short link.

apply.tooltip_empty: Pick a file or change the view permission below, then press this button
apply.nothing_pending: Pick a new file or change the view permission below, then press Update content.
apply.slug_note: The QR code is regenerated for the new path; the old path still redirects.
apply.partial_access: The content was replaced but the view permission could not be changed: {{reason}}
apply.partial_slug: Earlier changes were applied, but the path could not be changed: {{reason}}

update.title: Update content
update.status_refuses: This content is on hold and cannot be replaced right now. Follow the action shown for its current status, then try again.
update.delta_heavier: The new file is {{delta}} heavier than the old one — only that difference counts.
update.delta_lighter: The new file is {{delta}} lighter than the old one — that difference is given back.
update.delta_same: The new file is the same size — storage does not change.
update.keep_qr_title: QR code and short link stay the same
update.keep_qr_body: Printed standees, flyers and packaging open the new content. Recorded scans are kept.
update.draft_no_link_title: Not published yet, so no link or QR code
update.draft_no_link_body: Replacing the file now changes nothing outside.
update.lose_old_title: The old file is replaced for good
update.lose_old_body: After you press Update, {{name}} cannot be recovered. Download it first if you still need it.
update.kind_change_body: Scanners will see {{to_viewer}} instead of {{from_viewer}}. The QR code and short link stay the same.
update.wrong_type: Cannot open {{ext}} files. HTML, PDF, PowerPoint or video are accepted — export to one of those and try again.
update.quota_delta: This change needs {{delta}} more but only {{free}} is free. Taking down one other piece of content is enough.
update.quota_view_usage: See what is taking up space
update.progress_note: If you close this tab now, {{link}} still opens the old version — nothing breaks, it just has not changed yet.
update.progress_note_draft: If you close this tab now, nothing breaks — the old version is still there, it just has not changed yet.
update.unchanged_body: QR code, short link and recorded scans. Printed standees and flyers open the new version.
update.unchanged_body_draft: Name and unpublished status. The link and QR code arrive when you publish.
update.failed_old_kept: The QR code and short link still open {{name}} as before — nothing is broken. Please try again; if it keeps failing, contact support.
update.failed_old_kept_draft: The old version {{name}} is untouched — nothing is broken. Please try again; if it keeps failing, contact support.
update.gone_title: This content has been taken down
update.gone_mid_flight: Someone took it down while this dialog was open. Printed QR codes now lead to a taken-down notice. Create a new artifact if you need to publish again.

errors.wrong_type: Only HTML, Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image or video — up to {{max}}
errors.file_too_large: This file is {{size}}, over the {{max}} limit. Please choose a smaller one.
errors.upload_failed: The upload did not go through, please try again
errors.publish_failed_draft_kept: The file was uploaded but not published yet. Publish it from the detail page to try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong, please try again
errors.quota_live: You already have {{limit}} published artifacts, the maximum. Delete one and try again.
errors.removed: This artifact has been taken down and cannot be updated. Publish a new one.
errors.status_refuses_publish: This content is on hold and cannot be published right now. Follow the action shown for its current status, then try again.
errors.scan_infected: This file did not pass the safety check, so it was not uploaded. If you believe that is a mistake, please contact support.
errors.scan_encrypted: This file is protected by a password, so the system cannot open it for the safety check. Please upload a copy without a password.
errors.scan_unavailable: The file could not be safety-checked right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

access.conflict: Someone else just changed the view permission. Reload the page and try again.
access.title: Who can view

public.label: Public
public.description: Anyone with the link can view.

private.label: Private
private.description: Only members of your organization, after signing in to li2.

password.label: Password
password.description: Anyone who knows the password can view. You send it to them yourself.

google.label: Google sign-in
google.description: Anyone with a Google account can view. Their email is recorded.

access.private_note: People outside {{org}} who scan the code see a page saying it cannot be opened — not the content.
access.google_note: Viewer emails show up under Customers. Only the email and the time are stored.
access.draft_note: This mode takes effect the moment you publish.
access.password_viewer_note: Viewers enter this password once and can view for a week.
access.password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
access.password_once: This is the only time the password is shown. Copy it and send it to whoever needs to view.

dialog.keep_qr_title: QR code and short link stay the same
dialog.keep_qr_body: Changing the view mode takes effect immediately and creates no new link.
dialog.leaving_password: Anyone currently viewing with the old password will have to authenticate again.
dialog.success: View permission is now {{mode}}. QR code and short link are unchanged.
dialog.failed: Could not change the view permission. The link is still {{mode}}. Please try again.

access.section_live_note: Changing the mode takes effect right away and does not create a new link.

viewers.none_hint: Once someone signs in with Google to view it, their email shows up under Customers.
viewers.anonymous: Li2 collects no emails — viewers stay anonymous
viewers.anonymous_hint: With {{mode}} access, viewers never say who they are, so Li2 has no email for them. This is not "nobody has opened it": people may well have viewed it and we cannot tell who. Switch to Google sign-in and every viewer from that point on is recorded.

quick.title: Drop a file here to publish it right away
quick.hint: Gets a random public path. Use the Create button if you need a name or password.
quick.published_no_link: Published, but no link came back. Open the detail page to see it.
quick.publish_failed_draft: Upload finished but publishing failed. The file is a draft in the list.
